strDesc: The Langdon-Phillips Standard Issue gas pump, commonly found on their warships as part of the life support system. Will draw gas from any enclosed container or room, and pump those contents into the target area. Can link to relevant alarms to maintain safe cabin pressure. This is a heavy-duty model, featuring the ability to switch to dual-intake mode for flexibility in deployment.
